examples.description: Put a b-roll clip on the timeline at 6 seconds

description: Place an existing video/image asset on a b-roll track at a position: the first b-roll track, or the one track_id names (a later b-roll track draws over an earlier one, for picture-in-picture). Overlap on that track is refused with the conflicting range so you can re-place or stack it on another track.

project_id.description: The studio project (vp_…) this tool acts on.

track_id.description: A video-broll track (vtr_) from get_composition; defaults to the first one.

name: studio.add_clip_to_timeline
